repos_data.description: A complete set of volatility estimators based on Euan Sinclair's Volatility Trading

C++ 17 based library (with sample applications) for testing equities, futures, currencies, etfs & options based automated trading ideas using DTN IQFeed real time data feed and Interactive Brokers (IB TWS API) for trade execution. libtorch/lstm/cuda demo. Support for Alpaca & Phemex. Notifications via Telegram.
A Python library for evaluating option trading strategies.
Options trading and research system in C++23: one event-driven engine for backtest and live trading on Interactive Brokers, a quant lab on the same data, and MCP tools for AI agents.

Actively maintained Python client for the Robinhood API, and a migration path off robin_stocks. Keeps scheduled scripts alive: sessions renew from a stored refresh token, so no password or device approval prompt. Typed responses, options, futures, IRA and crypto.
High-performance, Polars-native technical analysis & backtesting — 221 indicators, Rust + Python, bit-identical streaming/batch parity

Systematic options trading intelligence for small accounts. Create desks in your portfolio, allocate capital and risk appetite at Desk Level. Every trade generated by system is specific for the desk keeping in mind capital allocation, risk limits, position sizing
A modular research pipeline that turns trending Reddit discussions into structured market events and options trade ideas.
Reproducible ERN and WealthyOption backtests on SPXW/XSP, with published results, postmortems, and a Java workflow for importing historical data and rerunning each strategy.
Realistic limit-order fill simulator for options credit/debit spreads. Engine-agnostic, data-source-agnostic.
A model-driven options pricing, Greeks, and backtesting library — real Black-Scholes/binomial pricing and Greek-attributed P&L, not just historical-data buckets.

MCP server for ApexVol options analytics — options chains, IV rank, VRP, Greeks, GEX, expected moves, and screeners for Claude and any MCP client. Remote connector or pipx install; works with any paid ApexVol plan.
Dealer-gamma levels for TradingView - flip, call/put walls, 0DTE pinning - computed daily from real options data (NQ, DOW, Gold, DAX). Free yfinance + Eurex ODAX pipeline.
MCP server exposing the Greeks options-analytics API (Greeks, GEX, Max Pain, flow) as tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP client
